{"description":"Read spec section, extract MUST/SHALL/SHOULD statements, create checklist in task description

## Extracted Requirements from spec/02a-tdma.md (Section: Multi-Root Beacon Conflict Handling)

### MUST Requirements
- [ ] R1: The beacon with the higher stratum (lower numerical value for the TimeStratum field) MUST be preferred
- [ ] R2: If strata are equal, a node MUST prefer the beacon from the root with the lowest IID (treated as a 64-bit unsigned integer)
- [ ] R3: A node MUST verify the Schnorr signature on every beacon before considering any field
- [ ] R4: Beacons with invalid or missing signatures MUST be silently discarded regardless of stratum or IID
- [ ] R5: After switching roots, the node MUST send a new DAO with the new parent and reset its SFN relative to the new root's epoch
- [ ] R6: MUST NOT switch roots more than once per superframe to prevent flapping

### MUST Requirements (DRIFTING state)
- [ ] R7: While DRIFTING, a node MUST NOT adopt beacons from a different root unless the beacon's stratum is lower (better) than the previous root's stratum
- [ ] R8: At equal stratum, the node MUST remain with its current root

### SHOULD Requirements
- [ ] R9: A node that was SYNCED and encounters a beacon with a higher stratum (better time source) SHOULD re-evaluate its root preference"}
